model.description: BUILT (repo-registry.ts ROOTS.oosh): the 'oosh' root resolves BY CONSTRUCTION to path.resolve(os.homedir(),'oosh') - the HOME/oosh SYMLINK path, NOT realpath'd/canonicalized, and the OOSH_DIR env override is DROPPED. HOME/oosh is a symlink that `oo` mode-switch repoints to a worktree; keeping the symlink path (not canonicalizing) makes git FOLLOW it to the CURRENT oo-mode dynamically, so diff+header+save all use whatever HOME/oosh points at now (currently mcdonges.latest). ROOT: OOSH_DIR had been misconfigured to the FIXED Once.sh/dev worktree (HEAD dev-teampush-astray) -> center header showed the wrong branch. Correct-by-construction: never rely on a misconfigurable env for ground truth.
